display_title: Grand Duchess of the North, It's Cold
description:
I, someone who has an almost pathological hatred of the cold, somehow ended up transmigrating into the body of the Grand Duchess of the North. But of all places, why the freezing North?! Desperate to escape what feels like certain death by freezing, I try to run away, but every single attempt is foiled by the Grand Duke, who relentlessly brings me back. 

 *“Run away as much as you want. I’ll just catch you every single time.”* 

In the original story, I’m pretty sure this couple was supposed to end on bad terms—so why is he so obsessed with me? I’m telling you, I can’t survive here in this freezing cold! (Source: Naver Webtoon, translated)
